entries.title: One-Button Arcade
entries.label: Hardware
entries.summary: A pocket-sized arcade with a lifetime press counter, a timed speed round, and saved high scores. One mechanical switch handles play and initials entry; a custom 3D-printed enclosure brings the display, board, and wiring together.

entries.title: Pi Constellation Mapper
entries.label: In progress
entries.summary: A handheld night-sky explorer and constellation sketchbook. The prototype pairs a Raspberry Pi, touch display, GPS, and orientation sensor with a Rust interface for exploring the sky and creating custom constellations. Enclosure prototypes focus on component fit and usability.

entries.title: C/C++ Programming
entries.label: Coursework
entries.summary: Programs built with linked data structures, classes, inheritance, iterators, and dynamic memory. Practiced modular C and object-oriented C++, using compiler warnings and test cases to work through pointers, input handling, and binary data.

entries.title: Brass & Barley
entries.label: Game project
entries.summary: A custom Minecraft modpack centered on mechanical building, farming, and brewing. A curated mod list, compatibility fixes, and an in-game quest guide turn a collection of mods into a connected experience.

entries.title: Fantasy Draft Command Center
entries.label: Side project
entries.summary: A small browser app for keeping fantasy-football draft day organized, with saved draft state and offline support.

entries.title: Woods Coffee
entries.summary: Provide friendly, accurate service during busy shifts. Work with coworkers to maintain quality, follow procedures, and resolve day-to-day problems while communicating clearly with customers and the team.

entries.title: University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa
entries.summary: Planned and led community programs, explained policies to a diverse group of residents, and responded to resident concerns. Coordinated with the staff team in time-sensitive situations.

entries.title: Summer Apprenticeship
entries.summary: An earlier summer apprenticeship. Program details and the work I did there will be added soon.

entries.title: WWU Racing
entries.summary: Part of the low-voltage and electronics team. WWU Racing is Western's student engineering team, building an electric race car for Formula SAE competition.

entries.title: TORCH
entries.summary: Served as a student tutor with Technology Outreach Hawaii, helping others learn through tutoring and clear communication.
